system_a.summary: Across the reviews, guests consistently describe a clean, quiet, private basement apartment with a separate entrance, easy check-in, responsive hosts, and good value. Recent reviews (2024–2026) repeat these themes, praising the location near Asheville, peaceful mountain setting, comfort, and reasonable price. Several recent guests note it is a simple, basic space, and one called it a good place to crash for the night. Limitations mentioned in recent reviews include a steep walk up from the parking area, which one guest said could be hard for older people. Older, historical reviews raised more concerns: no lockable door and no window coverings (2015–2019), a sagging bed, spiders, weak water pressure and a toilet backup, hearing hosts overhead, limited temperature control, and a few unpleasant host interactions. Whether these older issues persist is not shown in recent reviews, which don't mention them.

system_b.summary: Guest reports on this basement suite are mixed, and the most serious concerns are older. Reviews from 2015–2019 said the private entrance door couldn't be locked, the garage was sometimes left open, and windows lacked curtains or blinds; one guest advised removing valuables. Other guests called the neighborhood safe, and many praised the private entrance and separate space (2016–2023). Whether security or window coverings have changed is unknown. A minority described steep, rocky, narrow access, including a March 2024 comment. Overhead noise from the hosts appeared in 2017 and 2019 reviews, though many guests found it quiet. Some 2017–2019 guests reported host friction, a sagging bed, and plumbing problems, while recent reviews (2024–2026) are positive about hosts, check-in, cleanliness, and value. Guests describe a basic, no-frills suite about 10–20 minutes from downtown Asheville, where a car is needed. Several 2025 reviews use near-identical wording and may not be independent.

selected_claims.claim: Door to the private entrance could not be locked (left unlocked by owners). Reviewers reported unease; one noted the garage door left open for long periods and that there was no way to lock off upstairs guests, and advised removing valuables. One also called the neighborhood seemingly safe, and another later called it safe.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Lock/security complaints date from 2015 to 2019; no recent (2024-2026) reports either way. Positive neighborhood-safety comments 2015, 2020, 2024.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Cannot confirm whether the door is still unlockable today; a 2019 review mentions a coded entry (R0046), suggesting access may have changed, but this is not confirmed.

selected_claims.claim: Windows lacked curtains or blinds, so some guests felt privacy from outside was inadequate; one reported only a sheer covering and morning light.
Many guests praised the private entrance, separate space and privacy, including a private porch/deck.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Privacy praise coexists with the window-covering concerns.

selected_claims.claim: Access can be physically difficult: steep, rocky driveway, a steep walk uphill from parking that may be challenging for older people, a narrow (~2 ft) passage between stairs and wall to reach the door, and a steep winding mountain road.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports span 2017-2024; the accessibility comment (R0089) is from March 2024, the most recent.
selected_claims.uncertainty: A minority of reviewers; most others described access as easy. Unclear whether conditions changed.

selected_claims.claim: Noise from the hosts living above was reported by a couple of guests (audible footsteps, early-morning stomping); many more guests described the place as quiet and peaceful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints 2017 and 2019; quiet praise continues through 2024.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Overhead noise depends on host activity; no recent complaints.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is overwhelmingly described as easy, with clear instructions and private entry, including recent stays.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Minor complaints: confusing house numbers (2015), no drop-off at driveway (2024).

selected_claims.claim: Hosts are mostly praised as responsive and welcoming, but a few guests reported friction: feeling like an inconvenience over parking and noise, being blamed for a plumbing backup, a refused partial refund, and an undisclosed per-guest fee.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports 2017-2019; recent reviews (2024-2026) are positive.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Single-guest accounts, unverified; no recent negatives.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is very consistently praised, including recently; isolated reports of spiders and missing soap.
